svg.text: Event-driven delivery-slot booking · Saga per payment choice · agent dispatch · an escrow ledger that always balances
H3 res-9 zones · res-8 area names
KRaft · JSON event envelope · keyed by orderId · retry 2x → .DLT · readers ignore unknown fields
payment.* · slot.confirm · slot.confirmed · slot.release · refund.* · delivery.assigned · delivery.completed · escrow.release · cod.collect
pick a slot, pay or COD,
Customer holds a slot — Redis Lua decrements only if capacity > 0, so it never overbooks
Order for a purchase — PREPAID and CASH skip payment; ONLINE starts the payment step
ONLINE: payment.requested → gateway A, falls back to B → payment.captured into escrow
slot.confirm → hold CONFIRMED → slot.confirmed (area, date, hours) → order CONFIRMED
dispatch picks the least-loaded agent in that area → delivery.assigned → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY
Admin marks it delivered → delivery.completed → order DELIVERED, customer notified
escrow.release (PREPAID, ONLINE) or cod.collect (CASH) → the merchant is paid
payment.failed → slot.release returns the place → order FAILED, purchase free to retry
Unpaid holds expire after 5 minutes — a scheduled sweeper releases them
Every step is idempotent: processed_events per consumer, and the ledger always balances
